text: This is the second half of the mock exam started in Lesson 40 — nine more questions, same timed format. Together the two halves add up to a realistic-scale mock exam.
Set a timer for eighteen to twenty minutes, answer all nine before checking any explanation, then review in one pass. Take this in a separate sitting from Part 1, with a real break in between.
This half leans slightly more into Domain 3 — sensitivity labels, access reviews, blue-green deployment, observability versus the Monitoring Hub — while still mixing in Domains 1 and 2.
Once scored, combine your miss list with Part 1's and sort all eighteen by domain. A domain showing up across both halves is a real signal, not noise.
Both halves of the mock exam are done. Next up: closing out the whole DP-700 chapter, and previewing what's next in the course.
